source_response.Name: Juliana Caravaggio
source_response.What is one thing you are hoping to lear: I am excited to learn further in depth about programming when it comes to exercise selection and progression. Learning beyond standard strength training and diving deeper into other categories of fitness such as cardiovascular and power exercises is something I'm looking forward to.
source_response.What, if anything, do you feel is holdin: I just started this past month at Equinox, and I am new to the practice of making sales. I am attentively observing and practicing as I've been onboarding, and my approach has been successful thus far. Learning and strengthening my skills when it comes to approaching members on the floor is something I aim to achieve as a result of this curriculum. I have yet to deal with retention of clients as I just started, but that is something I want to cover so that when the time comes, I will have provided enough value and insight that my client will want to purchase another package.
source_response.Strengths and confidence: What skill are: I have a very strong growth mindset as I approach every day as an opportunity to learn something new and achieve something different. My ability to put myself in others' shoes and genuinely listen to their stories and needs has been a skill that I have carried with me ever since I was much younger. I think these two skills come out especially during the Equifit and CPT when I can learn the most information and relay it back to them in a program that is specifically tailored to their needs and goals.
source_response.Growth and development: Which skill area: Continuing to challenge myself daily to step out of my comfort zone when it comes to approaching members is a skill that I have already seen start to grow, and I know it will continue over time and with practice. Obtaining my own leads through regular conversation is something I'm excited for, and my success in that area will make the biggest impact.
source_response.Learning and preparation: Write any ques: I am excited to learn more about different approaches to floor shifts, and some techniques to use to successfully gain leads in that space. I am also interested in learning how to build my own personal brand and business to further my reach as a coach.
